AS51_GRID.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept game animation source sheet. Asset type: candidate full-body 2D cel sheet for existing TMB female Dao Tu AS51. Preserve exact master face, large amber eyes, black high ponytail/red ribbon, jade ornament, red-black-gold outfit, proportions, silhouette and seams. 4×4 transparent sheet; four square columns and rows; no labels/dividers. Rows: Walk_Front cycle; Cast_Front settle/gather/release with no effect/recovery; Hit_Front anticipation/impact/recoil/recovery; Downed_Front stumble/knee/fall/settled. Every frame genuinely different. Front-facing, stable identity and full-body. No weapon, VFX, blur, extra character, text, watermark or background.
